rules.rule: Wenia Elixir style guide: Errors are functions in DomainErrors (ERR-5); failures returned as {:error, DomainErrors.name()} (ERR-4); never rename an error atom (ERR-5, ERR-11). Source: wenia-elixir-style-guide (rules 0.1.0). Read the repo AGENTS.md first: skip a rule only when it names an override for that rule ID; legacy code untouched by the diff is not rewritten (CF-1). Severity: bugs, security, data loss, money or compliance risk = high/critical; a broken Must rule in new code = medium (blocking); Should = low; cite the rule ID in every finding.
